data.name: Blaster Shooter GunGuy!
data.detailed_description:
Nova atualização

Controller Support, Updated Audio, Difficulty Tweeks


Acerca do jogo

His mother was a Ninja, his father was a Gun. But now, GunDad has been kidnapped. And it's up to you, GunGuy , to go out into the world and SAVE GUNDAD!

Blaster Shooter GunGuy is a challenging 2D action platformer with collectathon elements. Designed to be difficult but fair you take on the role of GunGuy and jump n shoot your way through 56 different levels comprising 7 worlds with each world culminating in a boss battle. Every stage holds three gems, collect them to unlock more playable characters. Each world also hold a unique challenge level that will test your prowess and if completed will also reward you with an additional playable character. All playable character have their own stat changes; some hit harder, some jump higher, but each is unique in their own way. Blaster Shooter GunGuy features Steam Trading Cards so you collect inside the game and out!

FEATURES
  • Challenging 2D Action Platformer!
  • More Than 50 Levels Spanning 7 Completely Different Worlds!
  • 7 Difficult Boss Battles!
  • Dozens of Collectibles!
  • Difficult Challenge Stages to Test Your Skills!
  • Unlock More Playable Characters To Keep The Fun Going!
  • Steam Trading Cards!

reviews.review:
This game is a standard shooter game, however it is heavily flawed.
The very first thing i saw that was horribly wrong was the main menu.
After a basic title screen with flashing instructions it greets me with a boring new / load game select screen with;
Default font. No background or imagery. And no music, which actually feels like somewhat of a relief as you will see.

- The music sounds like overused stock loops from 2006 (FUCKING KEVIN MACLEOD MUSIC!! SERIOUSLY!?!?), and the graphics look like they were made in 5 minutes, meaning they also look stock. EDIT: recently, with the rebalance of level 1-4, i was able to make it to the first boss, which uses the exact same music the regular stages for that zone had. This is just terrible.

- The controls feel broken and confusing with the sprinting acting like a dash ability. The worst part about said sprint / dash is that to be able to use it you have to be moving already, which, when compared to how sprinting / dashing works normally in games, is just plain wrong. EDIT: The recent update with controler support did not fix tis issue, however it did make it mildly more tolerable.

- I have not played much of the game but i can say with certainty that the frogs need to be balanced as they are able to jump to my position in one leap even if i just entered it's (very large) line of sight.
EDIT: the pirate ship fight also needs to be balanced, with the boss spawning pirates too often, meaining i end up with a party of about 6/8 pirates chasing me at one time.

- Thats another thing that feels stock and childish. The enemies, the first three you encounter being a frog a bird and a scorpion. ( i THINK its a scorpion at least)

- As previously mentioned, onscreen instructions for when you die or beat a level flash on and off the screen making them hard to read.

Overall this game does not even feel like it was worth the 65p i spent on it.

2 / 10
reviews.developer_response:
I appreciate your constructive review and will take to heart much of what you said. There are a few things I wanted to address however if that's okay with you.

-Enemy Variety
As you said you didn't get very far into the game but there are different types of enemies in each world. The world after the Desert has Trent's,Bears. The Iceland stage has Abominable snowmen, and regular snowmen. There are dinosaurs later as well as aliens too.

-The Frog
The Frogs are one of the easiest enemies in my opinion so I'm not 100% sure what the problem is with them? Can you explain more to me?

-Flashing Instructions
They're only 4 words so I don't think it's that hard to read them, but I could easily add an option to disable the flashing effect if that seems reasonable to you.

Thank you for being constructive in your criticism. I'll definitely try to improve upon the other things you've mentioned in the future.
